rows.text: For the full year 2026, the company now expects consolidated revenue of approximately $92.6 billion, non-GAAP adjusted operating profit of approximately $8.75 billion, non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS of approximately $7.28, and non-GAAP adjusted free cash flow of approximately $6.1B.

For the full year 2026, the company is raising its guidance for consolidated revenue to approximately $91.2 billion, consolidated non-GAAP adjusted operating profit to approximately $8.65 billion, and non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS to approximately $7.22.
